data.title: Nvidia’s New Partner Says Banks Want AI on Machines They Can Unplug
data.description: Big banks are demanding AI systems they can physically disconnect from the internet, and the CEO of one of Nvidia's newest partners says that changes everything about where the next trillion dollars in AI compute actually gets built.
